cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Apologize Properly
cards.instruction: Get someone to deliver the apology in the form, order, and setting you consider valid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Please apologise for eating my cake at the table where it happened.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry. Does that help?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. It's a promising rehearsal. The cake plate is over there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your dad's sitting there. Can't we do this privately?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He watched me blame the dog. Tell him you ate it before you tell me you're sorry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You looked so sure raising your paddle, I raised mine too. Lovely auction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was bidding on that wardrobe. You've just outbid me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I always begin with storage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put your paddle down before you buy the matching bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Let someone else make the beginner's mistake of buying a whole bedroom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my shoes beside yours for the interview. Very forward-thinking firm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are off because the heel broke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I prefer a preventative approach.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put yours back on. The interviewer is coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Shoes off for reception, on for the interview. Very clear progression.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please apologise for eating my cake at the table where it happened.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry. Does that help?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's a promising rehearsal. The cake plate is over there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your dad's sitting there. Can't we do this privately?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He watched me blame the dog. Tell him you ate it before you tell me you're sorry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your apology email needs a subject line mentioning the broken vase.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote 'sorry.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For all I know, that's about your choice of font.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send 'Sorry about the vase' to Mum. She still thinks you broke it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with 'I broke it.' My name comes out of the story before your apology goes in.

cards.title: Get It on the Record
cards.instruction: Get formal approval, endorsement, or acknowledgment before anyone can quietly revise their position.

cards.instruction: Get someone to accept an unwanted responsibility by proving that the rules, rotation, or tradition make it theirs.

beats.text: The patron applauds every donor. We couldn't have the later ones thinking their money mattered less.
